notes.title: "Star Leaping Story" at a New Lowest Price + All-New Version!
notes.notes:
The Steam Summer Sale has officially begun, and "Star Leaping Story" is now available at its lowest price ever! Thank you for your support!

At the same time, a new version and a music album have also arrived!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2971560/Star_Leaping_Story_Soundtrack/

Please refer to the following updates:

1. Added an easier difficulty mode for newcomers and a challenging hard mode for veterans.
2. The default experience is set to normal mode.
3. Various bug fixes and experience updates.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43185854/7c183f9258e843aa03017ea20c665e960bb23d4b.png

We hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: The multi-difficulty update is now available! Come and challenge the hard mode!
notes.notes:
The official version ver3.0 has been updated.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43185854/3536eb123eec60a0c5e0ad004e75a3f68039200e.png

1. Added Difficulty Selection:The difficulties are divided into Easy,Normal, and Hard
2. Lowered the difficulty of normal levels.
3. Lowered the difficulty of the finallevel and the gratitude level.4. Added a save point in the surface village.
5.Optimized the background images in the forest scenes.
6. Fixed text errors.
7. Fixed some detail errors.
